load_pretrained_vit_base: load a pretrained MAE ViT-B/16 model from Facebook AI and move it to the specified device
load_pretrained_vit_large: load a pretrained MAE ViT-L/16 model from Facebook AI and move it to the specified device
load_pretrained_vit_huge: load a pretrained MAE ViT-H/14 model from Facebook AI and move it to the specified device
create_vision_transformer_with_global_po: create a VisionTransformer model with global average pooling enabled for feature extraction
run_vision_transformer_forward: run a batch of images through the VisionTransformer forward pass to get patch embeddings
